articles.title: Blinkit or Bandits? Robbers in Delivery Uniforms Loot Ghaziabad Jewellery Store in Broad Daylight!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad: Two men disguised as food delivery agents looted a jewellery shop in broad daylight on Thursday. The robbery at Mansi Jewellers occurred around 3:30 PM and was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
Ghaziabad: Two men disguised as food delivery agents looted a jewellery shop in broad daylight on Thursday. The robbery at Mansi Jewellers occurred around 3:30 PM and was captured on CCTV.

The accused, wearing helmets and Blinkit and Swiggy uniforms, forcibly entered the store, pushed an employee aside, and began looting ornaments. One was seen throwing a chair across the counter to grab more items, while the other stuffed jewellery into a backpack.

Within minutes, the duo fled on a two-wheeler. Around 20 kg of silver and 125 grams of gold were stolen.

The shop owner said he was in the washroom during the incident and rushed out after hearing the caretaker shout “chor chor.” Police reached the spot within 20 minutes and launched an investigation.

articles.title: Kanpur Horror: SUV Flies Like Toy After Crashing Divider — Shocking CCTV Footage Goes Viral!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking accident was caught on camera in Uttar Pradesh’s Kanpur Dehat. A high-speed Mahindra Scorpio lost control and rammed into the highway divider shortly after crossing the Bara Toll Plaza, under Akbarpur Police Station limits.

body.html:
A shocking accident was caught on camera in Uttar Pradesh’s Kanpur Dehat. A high-speed Mahindra Scorpio lost control and rammed into the highway divider shortly after crossing the Bara Toll Plaza, under Akbarpur Police Station limits.

The SUV hit the divider with such force that it bounced and spun 5–6 times on the road, resembling a toy car. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral on social media.

Fortunately, no casualties were reported. Police reached the spot promptly, removed the damaged vehicle, and confirmed smooth restoration of traffic.

Police responded to the viral video, stating: “There has been no loss of life in the incident. The crashed vehicle has been removed promptly, and traffic is flowing normally.”

articles.title: Humanity Shamed in Ayodhya: Elderly Woman Abandoned on Road at Night, Found Wounded and Speechless
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ayodhya: In a heart-wrenching incident, two women and a man abandoned an elderly woman on a deserted road in Ayodhya under the cover of night. CCTV footage shows the trio bringing her in an e-rickshaw and fleeing, leaving her helpless on the roadside.

body.html:
Ayodhya: In a heart-wrenching incident, two women and a man abandoned an elderly woman on a deserted road in Ayodhya under the cover of night. CCTV footage shows the trio bringing her in an e-rickshaw and fleeing, leaving her helpless on the roadside.

Locals discovered her lying unconscious the next morning. Police immediately admitted her to Darshan Nagar Medical College. Her condition is critical—she is unable to walk or speak and has a visible wound on her throat.

Authorities are appealing to the public to help identify the woman, as she is unable to communicate her identity. Residents of Ayodhya are urged to come forward with any information.

articles.title: Slippers, Abuse & Chaos: Woman Creates Scene at Lucknow Petrol Pump — Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow: A dramatic altercation broke out at Patrakarpuram Chowk in Gomtinagar, where a woman was caught on camera threatening men with her slippers during a fuel queue dispute. The video quickly went viral on social media, drawing widespread attention.

body.html:
Lucknow: A dramatic altercation broke out at Patrakarpuram Chowk in Gomtinagar, where a woman was caught on camera threatening men with her slippers during a fuel queue dispute. The video quickly went viral on social media, drawing widespread attention.

The woman claimed she had arrived first and demanded fuel be filled in her vehicle before anyone else. She was seen pushing a man’s bike and hurling abuses when questioned about her whereabouts. When one of the men attempted to call police on 112, she allegedly tried to snatch his phone and responded with offensive language.

Despite the heated exchange, petrol pump staff and bystanders chose not to intervene.

In a similar incident from Jammu’s Canal Road on Wednesday, a woman was caught on video threatening a man with a machete during another minor dispute — also sparking public shock.

articles.title: Kolkata Metro Vandalised Mid-Journey, CCTV Video Sparks Outrage – Hunt On for Offender
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kolkata: A shocking CCTV video from a running Kolkata Metro train has gone viral, showing a passenger defacing the door of a coach by spraying black paint, while fellow commuters looked on without intervening. The incident occurred on the Blue Line when Metro rake no.

body.html:
Kolkata: A shocking CCTV video from a running Kolkata Metro train has gone viral, showing a passenger defacing the door of a coach by spraying black paint, while fellow commuters looked on without intervening.

The incident occurred on the Blue Line when Metro rake no. MR-409 was in motion. The accused, seen pulling out a spray can from his bag, sprayed Door No. 5 of Coach 4036 and exited the train shortly after.

Metro Railway Kolkata issued a statement confirming the act and condemned the damage to public property, calling it a blow to the "aesthetic look of the coach" and the sentiments of metro users. Authorities have warned strict action and urged commuters to stay vigilant.

Despite clear CCTV footage, the offender remains unidentified. Police and Metro officials are actively investigating.

articles.title: Tragedy in Mandi: HRTC Bus Falls into Gorge, 5 Dead, 20 Injured — Rescue Ops On
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mandi, Himachal Pradesh: In a devastating accident near Tarangla close to Maseran in Sarkaghat sub-division, an HRTC bus skidded off the road and fell nearly 25 metres into a gorge today, leaving five dead and around 20 injured.

body.html:
Mandi, Himachal Pradesh: In a devastating accident near Tarangla close to Maseran in Sarkaghat sub-division, an HRTC bus skidded off the road and fell nearly 25 metres into a gorge today, leaving five dead and around 20 injured.

The bus was travelling from Sarkaghat to Durgapur when the mishap occurred. As per Mandi SP Sakshi Verma, four people — two men and two women — died on the spot. Later updates confirmed the fifth fatality.

Rescue teams, including local police and 108 ambulance services, reached the site swiftly and carried out evacuations on steep terrain. Three critically injured passengers were referred to AIIMS Bilaspur, while others are being treated at Sarkaghat Civil Hospital.

The exact cause of the accident is still under investigation. Authorities are verifying the number of passengers; initial estimates suggest around 31 were on board.

SP Verma said, “Necessary legal action is being taken; figures are being confirmed.”

This is a developing story. Updates awaited.

articles.title: Arjuna Awardee Deepak Hooda Nearly Drowns in Ganga — Dramatic Rescue Caught on Camera
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Former Indian Kabaddi captain and Arjuna Awardee Deepak Hooda was swept away by the strong currents of the River Ganga in Haridwar on Wednesday. The incident occurred during the ongoing Kanwar Yatra.

body.html:
Former Indian Kabaddi captain and Arjuna Awardee Deepak Hooda was swept away by the strong currents of the River Ganga in Haridwar on Wednesday. The incident occurred during the ongoing Kanwar Yatra.

Hooda, who accidentally fell into the river, was dramatically rescued by the 40th Battalion of the Uttarakhand Police. A viral video posted by the police on X shows officers bravely leaping into the water from a boat to save him. Despite the strong current dragging the boat, the team successfully pulled Hooda to safety and brought him ashore.

The Kabaddi star expressed deep gratitude towards the police for saving his life.

Notably, Hooda, who is married to international boxer Saweety Boora, was earlier named in a dowry harassment case filed by his wife in February this year.

Drowning cases have risen sharply during the Kanwar Yatra season. The SDRF has reported multiple rescues this month, including six Kanwariyas at Kangra Ghat. In separate past incidents, a 19-year-old IAF personnel’s son and a 16-year-old boy lost their lives to Ganga’s dangerous waters.
